guide-entry-3a66a7f1bdd7dd6df15c8e6b.description: Discussion of the inclusion of the topic in the programme of work, and of the methodological approach of the Special Rapporteur, including terminological issues. Review of the debate on the topic in the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly, and of the previous work of the Commission and other international legal bodies. Overview of available material on due diligence in international law from the late nineteenth century to the present. Identification of issues and questions to be examined, and discussion of the possible form of the final outcome and future programme of work. First report of the Special Rapporteur , Ms. Penelope Ridings ( 77th session of the ILC (2026)) A/CN.4/792
